_comment: Volume-farming mode (docs/FARMING.md). Market-neutral 5-minute pair trading on majors, built to generate genuine two-asset volume at close to zero cost on a ZERO-FEE venue. Signals use Hyperliquid prices; execution goes to `venue` ("lighter" via src/exec/lighter_bridge.py, or "hyperliquid" — but Hyperliquid's 1.5/4.5 bp fees make farming there cost ~$450 per $1M). Paper mode simulates the venue's costs from `overrides.costs`.
